about: Whitespace in a Formula (ADR-0047): kept where Excel keeps it, dropped where Excel drops it on entry, and refused where Excel refuses it. Transcribed from ExSheet.Engine.Tests' FormulaWhitespaceTests.

cases.name: ADR-0047: a Formula keeps the whitespace it was typed with before its tokens, as Excel does: "= 1 + 2"
ADR-0047: a Formula keeps the whitespace it was typed with before its tokens, as Excel does: "=A1 + B1"
ADR-0047: a Formula keeps the whitespace it was typed with before its tokens, as Excel does: "=SUM( A1:A3, 4 )"
ADR-0047: a Formula keeps the whitespace it was typed with before its tokens, as Excel does: "=IF(A1 > 0,\n  A1,\n  0)"
ADR-0047: a Formula keeps the whitespace it was typed with before its tokens, as Excel does: "=  -A1%"
ADR-0047: a Formula keeps the whitespace it was typed with before its tokens, as Excel does: "=\"a  b\" & \" c\""
ADR-0047: a Formula keeps the whitespace it was typed with before its tokens, as Excel does: "= Positions[PV]"
ADR-0047 (observed in Excel): whitespace at the end, and before a comma, is dropped on entry: "=A1+1  "
ADR-0047 (observed in Excel): whitespace at the end, and before a comma, is dropped on entry: "= Positions[PV] "
ADR-0047 (observed in Excel): whitespace at the end, and before a comma, is dropped on entry: "=SUM( A1:A3 , 4 )"
ADR-0047 (observed in Excel): whitespace at the end, and before a comma, is dropped on entry: "= sum( a1 , $b$2 )"
ADR-0047 (observed in Excel): whitespace at the end, and before a comma, is dropped on entry: "=A1+1\n"
ADR-0047 (observed in Excel): whitespace at the end, and before a comma, is dropped on entry: "=IF(A1\n, 1, 0)"
ADR-0047 (observed in Excel): a tab between tokens is refused, as are the other space characters: "=\tA1\t*\t2"
ADR-0047 (observed in Excel): a tab between tokens is refused, as are the other space characters: "=A1\u00a0+1"
ADR-0047: a tab inside quoted text is the text's own
ADR-0047 (observed in Excel): a Reference a deletion makes #REF! takes the whitespace before it
ADR-0047/0048: undoing a structural edit puts back the Formula's text exactly
ADR-0047: two Formulas that differ only in whitespace are different Entries
